summary: Rework Toolbar navigation into a four-column vertical grid.

changes.title: Browse a four-column Toolbar grid
changes.detail: The full Toolbar shows four actions across and three rows at a time, with vertical scrolling for additional actions. Larger icons use the full tile without gray icon cards. Drag reordering follows the vertical scroll, and Settings stays in the first position.

changes.title: Open Settings from the Toolbar footer
changes.detail: While Toolbar is open, the footer microphone slot becomes a Settings shortcut with a matching accessible action. The normal typing footer still provides voice input, and Settings remains the first item in the Toolbar grid.
